SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO

CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_SEC] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount
AS(
SELECT 
     BSA.ACCTCODE AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BSA.ACCTNAME AS CustomerAccountName
    ,BSA.DATE_OPEN AS CustomerAccountOpenedDate
    ,BSA.DATE_CLOSED AS CustomerAccountClosedDate
    ,convert(varchar,BSL.CLTCODE) AS CustomerId
    ,BSA.CURRCODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
    ,BSA.ACCTTYPE AS CustomerAccountTypeId
    ,BSA.CNAME AS CustomerAccountShortName
    ,BSA.LAST6_ACCT_NUM AS Last6AccountNumber
    ,BSA.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSA.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSL ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSL.ACCTKEY AND BSL.ISLATEST = 1 
WHERE (BSL.LINKCODE = 'P' OR BSL.LinkCode IS NULL) and BSA.ISLATEST = 1
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount;
--select count(1) from #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount
-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerAccountName)
,CONVERT(DATE,CustomerAccountOpenedDate)
,CONVERT(DATE,CustomerAccountClosedDate)
,CustomerId
,CONVERT(CHAR,IsoCurrencyCode)
,CustomerAccountTypeId
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerAccountShortName)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,Last6AccountNumber)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount 
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerAccountName)
,CONVERT(DATE,CustomerAccountOpenedDate)
,CONVERT(DATE,CustomerAccountClosedDate)
,CustomerId
,CONVERT(CHAR,IsoCurrencyCode)
,CustomerAccountTypeId
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerAccountShortName)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,Last6AccountNumber)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
     WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_TGT	TGT
ON isnull(SRC.CustomerId,'1') = isnull(TGT.CustomerId,'1')
AND SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA;
--select count(1) from #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA

UPDATE TGT 
SET
     CustomerAccountName = SRC.CustomerAccountName
    ,CustomerAccountOpenedDate = SRC.CustomerAccountOpenedDate
    ,CustomerAccountClosedDate = SRC.CustomerAccountClosedDate
    ,GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber = NULL
    ,CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
    ,ResponsibilityCenterId = NULL
    ,SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId = NULL
    ,LedgerId = NULL
    ,LedgerAccountNumber = NULL
    ,IsoCurrencyCode = SRC.IsoCurrencyCode
    ,CustomerAccountTypeId = SRC.CustomerAccountTypeId
    ,CustomerAccountApplicationNumber = NULL
    ,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BranchId = NULL
    ,CustomerAccountShortName = SRC.CustomerAccountShortName
    ,Last6AccountNumber = SRC.Last6AccountNumber

FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA DELTA 
ON isnull(DELTA.CustomerId,'1') = isnull(TGT.CustomerId,'1')
AND DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId  
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode  
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount SRC 
ON isnull(SRC.CustomerId,'1') = isnull(TGT.CustomerId,'1')
AND SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
  ;


-----------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccount  ( 
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountName
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerAccountClosedDate
,GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
,CustomerId
,ResponsibilityCenterId
,SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
,LedgerId
,LedgerAccountNumber
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CustomerAccountTypeId
,CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BranchId
,CustomerAccountShortName
,Last6AccountNumber
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,SRC.CustomerAccountName AS CustomerAccountName
,SRC.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,SRC.CustomerAccountClosedDate AS CustomerAccountClosedDate
,NULL AS GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
,SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,NULL AS ResponsibilityCenterId
,NULL AS SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
,NULL AS LedgerId
,NULL AS LedgerAccountNumber
,SRC.IsoCurrencyCode AS IsoCurrencyCode
,SRC.CustomerAccountTypeId AS CustomerAccountTypeId
,NULL AS CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,NULL AS BranchId
,SRC.CustomerAccountShortName AS CustomerAccountShortName
,SRC.Last6AccountNumber AS Last6AccountNumber
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,SRC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA DELTA
ON  DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId 
AND isnull(DELTA.CustomerId,'1') = isnull(SRC.CustomerId,'1')
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');



DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA;

END
GO
